title: Financial Acumen
overview: In today’s fast-paced business world, professionals are constantly faced with decisions that demand sound judgment and strategic thinking. Financial acumen—the ability to make informed and effective decisions backed by quantitative data—enhances your credibility, supports your strategic choices, and increases the likelihood of achieving business success.

This course bridges the gap between strategic, commercial, and financial aspects of decision-making. Participants will learn how operating decisions in procurement, production, and sales impact their organization’s profitability and financial standing. By combining real-world examples with hands-on financial tools, this course equips you with the insights and skills needed to evaluate past decisions and make well-informed future ones.
audience: This course is ideal for managers, supervisors, and staff from any function, including finance, who seek to enhance their understanding and use of financial information in decision-making.
methodology: This course uses a blend of interactive techniques, including consultant-led presentations, practical case studies, hands-on Excel applications, and group exercises. These methods ensure participants actively engage with the material and apply their newfound knowledge effectively.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define how their organization competes and identify competitive advantages that drive shareholder value.
Analyze how macroeconomic and industry-specific factors influence profitability and performance.
Understand and interpret the components of basic financial statements.
Evaluate their organization’s short-term and long-term financial viability and make informed commercial decisions.
Apply cost concepts to make strategic and financially sound decisions
